description: A saddled pig ridden with a carrot on a stick held: it walks where the player looks, up a 1-block step and down again; boosted by using the stick, turning south, then north; the stick put away (it is the server's again) and taken out; sneaking off, mounted again by clicking it with an empty hand, the stick taken out; sneaking off.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:carrot_on_a_stick
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
